title: How to Make a Real Apology

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say formally that you are sorry and take responsibility
vocabulary.note_ar: أكثر رسمية من sorry ويُستخدم مع موقف محدد
vocabulary.note_en: More formal than sorry; used for a specific situation.
vocabulary.example: I apologize for being late for our meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relaxed, not formal; used with friends and in daily life
not specific; can be used in many situations
vocabulary.example: "Sorry" is a general word for many situations.

vocabulary.meaning_en: about one exact thing or situation
vocabulary.example: Give a specific reason for the mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a way that is wrong for the situation
a word or thing that covers many different situations
small and not important / big and important
vocabulary.example: Sorry works for minor and major mistakes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit someone or something by accident while moving
stopping someone in a polite way, e.g. with "excuse me"
saying that something is your duty or your fault
vocabulary.example: A real apology means you accept responsibility.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sorry about something you did
vocabulary.example: I regret eating garlic before the meeting.
Don't blame him; it was my fault.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that someone is responsible for something bad
vocabulary.example: Don't blame E for my mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being able to wait calmly without getting angry
a kind, calm and polite way of behaving
vocabulary.example: She accepted my apology with grace.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something good for someone after you hurt or disappointed them
vocabulary.example: I missed your party. How can I make it up to you?

fine_lines.title: sorry vs excuse me vs I apologize
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sorry كلمة عامة وغير رسمية بعد خطأ صغير أو كبير. excuse me قبل أن تفعل شيئًا: لمقاطعة مهذبة أو جذب الانتباه أو طلب الإعادة. I apologize رسمية ومحددة وتعني أنك تتحمل المسؤولية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Sorry: general and informal, after a small or big mistake. Excuse me: before you do something (polite interruption, attention, asking to repeat). I apologize: formal, specific, and you take responsibility.

examples.sentence: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
I apologize for the mistake in your bill.

fine_lines.title: I was wrong vs It was my fault
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I was wrong تعني أن معلومتي أو رأيي كان خاطئًا. It was my fault تعني أنني المسؤول عما حدث فلا تلُم غيري.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I was wrong" = my information or idea was not correct. "It was my fault" = I am responsible; don't blame others.

examples.sentence: I was wrong; the meeting is on Tuesday, not Monday.
It was my fault the report was late.

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
expressions.meaning_ar: لو سمحت، هل يجلس أحد هنا؟
expressions.example: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here? - No, go ahead.

expressions.phrase: Excuse me, can you say that again?
expressions.meaning_ar: عفوًا، هل يمكنك أن تكرر ذلك؟
expressions.example: Excuse me, can you say that number again?

expressions.meaning_en: formal apology for a specific thing

expressions.example: Don't blame the team. That was my fault.

expressions.meaning_en: My idea or information was not correct.
expressions.example: I was wrong about the price.

expressions.phrase: What can I do to fix it?
expressions.meaning_ar: ماذا أستطيع أن أفعل لإصلاح الأمر؟
expressions.meaning_en: asking how to make things better
expressions.example: I'm sorry I broke your phone. What can I do to fix it?

expressions.phrase: How can I make it up to you?
expressions.meaning_en: asking what you can do to make the person happy again
expressions.example: I forgot your birthday. How can I make it up to you?
Sorry for the wait. I appreciate your patience.

expressions.meaning_en: nothing bad happened, so it's fine
expressions.example: You didn't break it? No harm, no foul.

grammar.title: Steps of a real apology
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) اعتذر وتحمّل المسؤولية (I apologize / It was my fault) ولا تقل but بعدها. 2) استمع إلى الشخص الآخر وهو يعبّر عن شعوره. 3) اسأل: What can I do to fix it? 4) لا تكرر الخطأ. ويمكنك أن تشكر الشخص: I appreciate your patience.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Apologize and accept responsibility; don't add "but". 2) Listen to how the other person feels. 3) Ask: What can I do to fix it? 4) Don't repeat the behaviour. You can also thank them: I appreciate your patience.
examples: I apologize. It was my fault.
What can I do to make this better?

grammar.title: Don't say "but" after an apology
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا قلت I'm sorry, but... فكأنك ألغيت الاعتذار، لأن ما بعد but يلوم الشخص الآخر.
grammar.explanation_en: "I'm sorry, but..." cancels the apology, because what comes after "but" blames the other person.
examples: Wrong: I'm sorry, but you were late too.
Right: I'm sorry. It was my fault.

questions.question: Which is the most formal way to say sorry and take responsibility?
questions.explanation_ar: I apologize رسمية وتعني تحمّل المسؤولية.
questions.explanation_en: "I apologize" is formal and takes responsibility.

questions.question: You want to sit next to someone on a bus. You say:
choices: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?
I apologize, is anyone sitting here?
questions.explanation_ar: قبل أن تفعل شيئًا نقول excuse me.
questions.explanation_en: Use excuse me before you do something.

questions.question: Why is "I'm sorry, but you were late too" a bad apology?
choices: "But" cancels the apology and blames the other person.

questions.question: "Don't blame him. It was my ___."
questions.explanation_ar: It was my fault = كان خطئي.
questions.explanation_en: It was my fault = I am responsible.

questions.question: After you apologize, what should you ask?
choices: What can I do to fix it?
questions.explanation_en: Ask how you can fix it.

questions.question: "Thank you for waiting. I appreciate your ___."
"I ___ eating garlic before the meeting." (I feel sorry I did it)
questions.explanation_en: Regret + -ing = feel sorry you did it.

questions.question: "I was wrong" means:
choices: My information or idea was not correct.
questions.explanation_ar: I was wrong تعني أن معلومتي كانت خاطئة.
questions.explanation_en: It means my idea or information was not correct.

questions.question: What is the hardest part of a real apology?
questions.explanation_en: The hardest part is not doing it again.
